watches.name: The Workhorse Backcountry
watches.description: The Backcountry was inspired by those off-the-map trails riddled with mud and grit. Each design detail stands up to the elements, making it sustainable against even the toughest trails.

watches.name: The Tide Tracker Two Watch Bundle

Midnight Edition Tide Tracker Accessory Bundle
Limited Edition Hooligan Nightfall
watches.description: The Limited Edition Hooligan Nightfall is a blacked-out Workhorse Chrono with subtle silver accents. This is a proper field watch for men, with one-hour chrono and highly durable components.

watches.name: Smokey Bear Collector's Box Set
watches.description: In celebration of Smokey Bear's 82nd Birthday on August 9th, VERO Watch Company and Shwood Eyewear have teamed up to create a Limited Edition Smokey Bear Collector's Box Set. Each custom built set includes an Morning Sky Edition Smokey Bear watch and a pair of Shwood Eyewear Auburn Wood Smokey Bear Sunglasses, individually numbered out of 100.

watches.name: The Smokey Bear Blue Skies Edition
watches.description: The Smokey Bear Blue Skies Edition is inspired by the bright blue skies that follow responsible stewardship of our wild places. VERO's best selling field watch is now available in a striking monochromatic pebble blue palette.

watches.name: Realtree Tide Tracker Midnight Edition
watches.description: The VERO X Realtree Tide Tracker Midnight Edition is a field watch with a moody matte black finish. The bold black color creates a bold, minimalistic aesthetic that commands attention. Despite its rugged appearance, the watch maintains a sleek, sophisticated profile. The tide-tracking function allows you to monitor high and low tides for up to 14 days, ensuring you're always prepared for changing water conditions.

specsRaw.REALTREE WATCH PAIRS WITH: 20mm Evening Tide FKM Rubber Strap $35.00 Add to cart 20mm Expedition Gold FKM Rubber Strap $35.00 Add to cart 20mm Vintage Khaki FKM Rubber Strap $35.00 Add to cart

watches.name: VERO X Scout Motors Terra Cotta Workhorse
watches.description: The VERO X SCOUT collaboration unites VERO's admiration for an iconic American automotive legend with the rugged reliability of our most durable standalone watch, the Workhorse Chrono. The result is a functional, design-forward chronograph that captures both brands’ shared spirit of adventure.

watches.name: Realtree Tide Tracker Outpost Black
watches.description: The VERO X Realtree Outpost Black Tide Tracker is a rugged men’s field watch designed for performance. The Realtree Tide Tracker Outpost Black is minimal by design, and bold in contrast. Its tide-tracking function can be set to monitor high and low tides for up to 14 days.

watches.description: The VERO X Realtree Tide Tracker Compass Blue is a rugged men’s field watch designed for performance. The Realtree Tide Tracker Compass Blue has crystal clear hues of deep blue waters. Its tide-tracking function can be set to monitor high and low tides for up to 14 days.

watches.name: The Smokey Bear Campfire Edition
watches.description: The Smokey Bear Campfire Edition watch draws colors from the red embers and gray ash of a campfire still alive with the potential for flame. It serves as a reminder that “If it’s too hot to touch, it’s too hot to leave.”

watches.name: Limited Edition One Moto Solar
watches.description: The Limited Edition One Moto Solar was completed just in time for the 16th annual One Moto show here in Portland, Oregon. We were proudly the official timekeepers of this year's event. We joined forces with the pioneers of the sport to design and build a watch that would commemorate this epic event.

watches.name: VERO X Wildwood Studio Edition Bronze
watches.description: Meet the Studio Edition, our first collaborative timepiece with Portland-based custom tailor Wildwood & Company. Designed to balance formal style with everyday wear, the watch reflects Wildwood’s vision of a distinct timepiece that complements bespoke suits while staying true to our commitment to producing products that are built to endure.

watches.name: Meridian Portland Sport
watches.description: The Meridian Portland manual wind watch is assembled in our shop in Portland, Oregon. The Portland dial is a fresh take on a classic watch style. Each style offers striking features like an exhibition caseback, contouring bracelet and leather strap, and a micro adjust NodeX clasp.

watches.name: The Smokey Bear 80th Edition Forest Green
watches.description: VERO is giving 10% of each sale of our Smokey Bear watches right back to the US Forest Service to support their efforts in preserving and protecting our forests for future generations.

specsRaw.The Smokey Bear 80th Anniversary Watch: commemorates the legacy of the forest fire prevention icon. Proceeds from each watch directly support the Smokey Bear message, helping to fund ongoing educational and awareness efforts.

watches.description: 10% of all Smokey Bear watch sales go directly back to the US Forest Service to assist in their continued efforts in protecting our nation's forests and grasslands.

watches.name: Meridian SickAlps Inspired Edition
watches.description: Roads were made for journeys, not destinations. We built an exclusive batch of finely crafted Meridians with Porsche's distinct "Peridot Metallic" dial color inspired by the epic adventure Evan Pollock (@pollockpictures) and Brock Turner (@966RoadTrip) took through the French Alps with the SickAlps Tour.

watches.name: Safari Special Limited Edition
watches.description: The Safari Special Limited Edition watch was built with skilled mechanics and precision timing. Only 55 made to commemorate the 55th anniversary of the Safari Special Mexican 1000 Race.

watches.name: Meridian Manual Wind Rambler
watches.description: The Meridian Manual Wind Series -the ultimate weekender watch. Hearkening back to our 36mm Rally and Sunset, the Meridian Manual Winds are an elevated redesign of this popular series. Both styles come with an articulated stainless steel bracelet and a leather band that compliments the distinctive dial. Take a closer look at all of the new features below. Fully assembled and regulated in our shop in Portland, Oregon. We offer a 10-year warranty against any damage. Past 10 years, we continue to offer service and support to ensure your watch runs to the highest standard. Click Here to learn more.

watches.name: Limited Edition Workhorse Hooligan
watches.description: The Limited Edition Hooligan has come and gone. This version was built for launch in January of 2023. A new version is on its way for early 2024! Sign up for our newsletter to get sneak peeks and early access!

watches.name: 36mm Hand Wound Series - Sunset
watches.description: Classic inspiration meets modern style. The 36 Series is built to last and well suited for any occasion. These hand wound watches are a gadget geeks dream. Both styles have a mechanical movement, leather strap, sapphire crystal, and an open display case back. The series comes with two distinct color ways. The Rally has a cream dial with red, white, and blue accent rings. The Sunset comes with a dark navy dial with yellow, orange, and red accent rings. 36mm Case Width Domed Sapphire Crystal Mechanical/hand wound movement with 42hr power reserve 100m Water Resistance Display case back Leather Strap The 36mm Hand Wound series was assembled, serviced, and regulated to +/- 5 seconds/day in our shop in Portland, Oregon.

watches.name: SW-Q Silver Falls Sunburst
watches.description: A watch built for all. The new SW-Q Series is our slimmest fitting watch yet. We designed this watch for those with a smaller wrist size, and crafted a band that contours and breathes, ensuring you have a comfortable fit year-round. Each SW-Q Series watch comes with a contouring black silicone strap with built-in spring bars for quick swap out.

watches.name: Workhorse Track Day
watches.description: Any good race requires proper training and the right gear that can be pushed through the paces. We felt inspired by the smooth gray asphalt under a rally car and the distinctive red that is a nod to a runners track.

watches.name: Workhorse Backcountry
watches.description: The Backcountry was inspired by those off-the-map trails riddled with mud and grit. Each design detail stands up to the elements, making it sustainable against even the toughest trails.

watches.name: Workhorse Canyon
watches.description: Like all great tactical gear, the Canyon takes design cues from all the tones of the deep desert, as well as the necessary utilities used to travel vast landscapes.

watches.name: 36mm AUTOMATIC LE
watches.description: The VERO x Worn & Wound 36mm Automatic LE was inspired by mid-century design, featuring a two-layer dial design with an applied index at 12. The dynamic play of finishes and levels creates a watch that changes in different lights. A timepiece that truly looks as good with a suit, as a jean jacket. One can even go for a swim with no concern.

watches.name: 36mm & 40mm Crew Automatics
watches.description: The Century Series Summit offers classic inspiration and modern style with the added versatility of two sizes, 36mm and 40mm. The 36mm watch case size is great for those with smaller wrists, making it a more unisex fit. While the 40mm is great for those with a bit larger wrists. Both sizes have contouring lugs, a domed sapphire crystal, and display case back to take a look at the Sellita SW-200 automatic movement inside. 36mm & 40mm Case Widths 18mm Inner Lug 316L Stainless Steel Case 100m Water Resistance Sellita SW-200 Automatic Movement Sapphire Crystal Leather Strap Parts manufactured and dials printed in our shop in Portland, Oregon. All Century Series watches were assembled, serviced and regulated to +/- 5 seconds/day in-house.

watches.name: VERO x WindUp Peak 38mm
watches.description: The Peak has a polished and brushed titanium case that houses the Swiss-made Sellita SW 200 movement. Featuring elegant blued hands and navy numerals on top of an ice white dial. With flamed blued screws displayed in the open case back the back of the watch is as classic as the font. Worn and Wound has supplied a Stone Model 2 premium leather strap to complete this instant classic of a timepiece.

watches.name: VERO x WindUp Granite 38mm
watches.description: The Granite case, crown, and case-back are finished using a solution treatment that gives the titanium an aged look and feel. The dial has been 6X’s pad printed to add depth and clarity. Worn & Wound has fit it to a Peanut Model 2 premium leather strap that features a soft leather wrist side finish that will wear with style and comfort.

watches.name: SW-SS
watches.description: The perfect match of sports performance and casual luxury. Built to withstand extreme conditions on land and in water, while seamlessly matching whatever the occasion might call for. 200m Water Resistance AR Coated Domed Sapphire Crystal Sellita SW-200 Automatic Movement 316L Stainless Steel Components Dual tone high polished bezel and lugs, straight grained sides and case back 40mm Monobloc Case (41mm at top of tapered case) 46mm lug to lug length 11.5mm Case to top of domed crystal SW & SW-SS were milled, assembled, tested and regulated to +/- 5 seconds/day in our shop in Portland, Oregon
